ROOT_CAUSE: The script likely reads the file in Windows-1252 encoding, which cannot represent Cyrillic characters, and then writes it again without specifying the correct encoding, resulting in mojibake.

FIX: Ensure the script specifies UTF-8 encoding when reading and writing the file. Use the following commands in the script:

```powershell
# Read the file with UTF-8 encoding
(Get-Content -Path "path\to\file" -Encoding UTF8) | Out-File -FilePath "path\to\file" -Encoding UTF8
```

This ensures the file is read and written in UTF-8 encoding, preserving the Cyrillic characters correctly
